summary: The agent failed verification on a warehouse fulfillment recovery task. The trace reveals a pattern: the agent used pandas for initial data inspection (which failed without --break-system-packages), then built the workbook with openpyxl but made critical structural errors. Key failures: (1) Used date formulas (=B4+1) instead of actual datetime values as required by the production-planning skill, (2) Used incorrect cumulative formulas (=D4-C4 instead of =C4-D4 for first row, =E4+C5-D5 for subsequent), (3) The verifier failed suggesting format/structure mismatch. The production-planning skill already exists and explicitly warns against date formulas and gives correct formula patterns, but the agent violated these. The skill needs stronger enforcement of its own rules and a clearer warehouse fulfillment variant that captures the three-product-line pattern seen here.
